purpose: Teach: 司祭/殿下/教皇/暗黒/破滅/連行/暴落/批准

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、教会の司祭から目撃情報を警察、伺いました
lines.en: We received an eyewitness account from the church priest regarding this case.
lines.style: Professional, measured tone. Direct statement with calm authority. Slight pause after the opening—the formality of official procedure. No rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、外国の殿下警備にも対応されているとのこと
lines.en: I understand the police also handle security details for foreign dignitaries.
lines.style: Curious, slightly deferential. Careful phrasing—he's asking but not quite asking. Lean into the question mark, but keep it gentle and respectful.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、教皇の来日警備、警察、ご尽力ですね
lines.en: So with the papal visit security, the police really did put in a lot of effort on this case.
lines.style: Quiet realization dawning. Respectful acknowledgment. Measured pace, thoughtful. A little awe underneath—recognizing the scope of the work without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、暗黒組織の摘発を進めております
lines.en: We're in the process of dismantling the criminal organization behind this.
lines.style: Procedural, factual. Steady confidence. The tone of someone briefing, not performing. Brief, definitive—no extra words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、計画の破滅を警察、未然に防いだんですね
lines.en: So the police managed to prevent the plan from falling apart beforehand.
lines.style: Thoughtful articulation. Ren working through the logic aloud, respectful. Slight wonder in the voice—the weight of what was prevented. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者を連行いたしました
lines.en: We've taken the suspects into custody.
lines.style: Closed statement. Professional finality. The tone that says 'this part is done.' Composed, measured. A note of resolution underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不正取引による暴落を警察、調査中ですね
lines.en: And you're still investigating the market collapse that resulted from the illegal transactions.
lines.style: Ren piecing it together. Respectful observation. Steady, deliberate pace. A note of understanding—this is larger than one arrest. Soft gratitude underneath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、条約批准に基づく対応を進めております
lines.en: We're proceeding with our response based on the treaty provisions.
lines.style: Formal, composed close. The tone of protocol respected. Each word carries weight. Slight finality—this is the briefing's conclusion. Professional warmth, not distance.
